description: The file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/NeuroticiIndex.csv' is already open in Jamovi. This dataset contains 2,694 participants' responses on five Neuroticism items (N1–N5) from the Big Five Inventory (Revelle, 2010), rated on a 1–6 scale (1 = Very Inaccurate, 6 = Very Accurate). Click 'Factor' in the top menu bar and select 'Reliability Analysis'. Move all five items — N1, N2, N3, N4, and N5 — into the 'Items' box. Under 'Scale Statistics', enable 'Cronbach's α' (already checked by default) and also enable 'McDonald's ω'. Under 'Item Statistics', enable 'Cronbach's α (if item dropped)' to see how each item affects the overall reliability.
